title: Zembiec
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of 11 back squats, 7 strict burpee pull-ups and a 400 m run, for time. Honours U.S. Marine Maj. Douglas A. Zembiec, the 'Lion of Fallujah', killed in a firefight in Baghdad in 2007. Each burpee pull-up is a strict push-up, a jump to a bar about 12 inches above your reach, and a strict pull-up.
